responsibility: Defines the helper builder that extracts and orders initializer values for Rust struct and tuple-struct construction when lowering to BIR. Given the resolved variant type as context, it visits only struct expression field forms, evaluates or resolves each field value, applies coercion to the declared field type, and returns the ordered PlaceId list consumed by InitializerExpr generation, separating field-layout-aware struct initialization from the general expression builder.
